AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, December 21, 2023, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on December 21, 2023, at 10:02 a.m.
  •  Present: Commissioners Vidor, Zadorian, Vice Chairperson Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar,
  Commissioner Pogosian
  •  Absent: Commissioner Yank, Commissioner Aleksandryan
  •  The Agenda for the December 21, 2023, Regular Meeting was posted on December 13, 2023, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the November 16, 2023 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.

  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded : Commissioner Zadorian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vidor, Zadorian, Vice Chairperson Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Yank, Commissioner Aleksandryan
  Abstain:  Commissioner Pogosian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
  • Ms. Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  • Nina Crowe, Chief Executive Officer for Glendale Arts thanked the Commission for their recent
  support and sponsorship of the Glendale International Film Festival. The Commission gave their
  input.

5. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - None

  1
 6. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. San Fernando Road Beautification Project – Decorative Fencing
  • Jenifer Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief update on San Fernando Beautification Project and stated
  Staff has been working with Public Works and Armen Avazian, Principal Civil Engineer, as the
  project lead. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated Public works is proposing two options for decorative
  fencing and stated Staff was looking for feedback from Commission. Mr. Avazian, Principal Civil
  Engineer was invited to share his update. The Commission asked questions and gave their
  recommendations.

  b. 2023-2024 Work Plan Progress Updates

  i.  City-Wide Public Art RFQ – Update:
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that the RFQ is now live and the deadline to apply for the RFQ is
  January 19, 2024 at 5pm (PST). For more information please visit:
  https://www.glendaleartsandculture.org/publicartrfq

  ii.  Mural Ordinance – Update:
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that Staff is working on drafting a Mural Ordinance. The draft Mural
  Ordinance and Policies and Procedures will be scheduled for initial review by the Commission at
  an upcoming Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

 iii.  Creative Crosswalks - Update
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief update on the Creative Crosswalks. She stated that Staff
  received 100 applications for consideration.
  • Ms. Loreto Lopez shared the finalists’ proposals for the Artsakh Ave crosswalks and briefly
  reviewed the applications with the Commission. The Commission asked questions and gave
  their recommendations and input.

 iv.  Neighborhood Arts – No update

 v.  Performing Arts – No update

 vi.  Arts and Cultural Events – No update

vii.  Marketing and Communications - Update
  The ACE Agency – Update:
  • Ms. Fukutomi- Jones stated that the ACE Agency is preparing a timeline and strategic plan and
  will be attending the Regular Arts and Culture Commission on January 18, 2024 to present.

7. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • The Commission thanked Staff and the collaboration of all the City Departments that work along
  with the Commission and wished everyone Happy Holidays.

8. ADJOURNMENT 10:53 p.m.
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is January 18, 2024,
  at 10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway (2nd Floor) Glendale, CA 91206.
